scope: Read-only original montage references plus existing project asset audit; only this diagnostic directory is written. No original EffectGroup contents or renderer types are available.
referencePolicy: Dg is a filename candidate filter only; no renderer/shape claim is inferred from the name.
included means bEnabled is not false AND NotifyTriggerChance > 0.
null transform/Attached fields mean not serialized in this JSON; they are inherited and not verified here. Do not convert null scale to zero.
Source LinkValue is montage position; use LinkValue, not EndLink.LinkValue, for point notify timing.

Mapped montage position = original montage position * project montage length / original montage length. This assumes the same untrimmed source motion, supported by current full-length single-segment references.

All current project montage RateScale, segment play rates and unlinked task Rate pins are 1 in the saved audit. Mapping is authored montage time, not a gameplay stopwatch. Playback-rate changes alter real time but must not multiply the notify position twice.

Approximately 30 source samples/s is observed from (NumFrames-1)/SequenceLength. The project length ratio is approximately 1.25; a 24 fps import is a plausible explanation, not verified import metadata.
Project Attack05 maps to original Attack04_1 by the actual referenced sequence; do not substitute an invented original AM_Attack05.

First version is an original red/gold arc preset plus filaments and sparks. Original transforms are artistic reference only; a newly modeled mesh has its own axis/origin/scale and requires preview alignment.

sourceEvents contains montage point/state events only; sourceSequenceEffects separately preserves underlying animation Effect windows. These extra state windows are not included in the proposed Dg-name burst count.
PlayOnEnd=true is recorded without assuming that its window start is its spawn time.

attacks.burstPolicy: Original reconstruction proposal: combine enabled _Dg-name candidates within 0.010 source seconds into one authored preset burst. Preserve each original subevent in sourceEvents. This is not evidence that Kuro uses one renderer or one slash per group.
